item.title: JanaVeteran Project Empowers ATM Veterans Through Ginger Farming
item.description:
Source: CodeBlue (Malaysia Health)
Boustead Plantations' JanaVeteran project enables Malaysian Armed Forces veterans to cultivate ginger, a high-value cash crop. Participants receive a guaranteed monthly income of RM2,000. Malaysia has low self-sufficiency for ginger at 15%. The post JanaVeteran Project Empowers ATM Veterans Through Ginger Farming appeared first on CodeBlue .

item.title: Johor Government Pays For Locum Doctors At Public Emergency Departments
item.description:
Source: CodeBlue (Malaysia Health)
The Johor state government is paying for locum doctor services at the green zone of the emergency departments of HSAJB and HSI to cut congestion and waiting times. Johor exco Ling Tian Soon says most of these locum doctors are existing government doctors. The post Johor Government Pays For Locum Doctors At Public Emergency Departments appeared first on CodeBlue .
